integration_issues.flow: Student login immediately after page load
integration_issues.issue: Race condition: loginStudent() reads localStorage ta_students synchronously, but Firestore onSnapshot hydration takes ~3-6s. Login attempted before hydration fails with 'Invalid credentials' even for a valid Firestore student (test1/test123). Same attempt succeeds after ~8s wait. Needs a 'syncing cloud data' loading gate / disabled submit until first snapshot, or a direct Firestore query on submit.
Documented demo student 'student/student123' no longer exists in Firestore, but the Login page 'DEMO ACCESS' hint still advertises it — misleading for real users.

action_items: Confirm/reset the Firebase Auth admin password for raceryug@gmail.com (verified failing via REST: 400 INVALID_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS) and update /app/memory/test_credentials.md; admin flow is currently unusable with documented creds.

Gate the login form (loading state / disable submit) until the first Firestore students snapshot arrives, or query Firestore directly on submit — currently a fast login attempt wrongly reports 'Invalid credentials'.
Update or remove the hardcoded 'Student -> student / student123' DEMO ACCESS hint on Login page since that student no longer exists in Firestore.

Security: Firestore rules allow unauthenticated READ of academy/main/students including plaintext passwords (verified via REST with the public API key). Writes are correctly denied (403). Consider hashing or moving student auth server-side.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/store.js loginStudent() is purely localStorage-based; in cloud mode there is no await on cloud hydration -> nondeterministic login failures.
Student passwords stored in plaintext in a publicly readable Firestore collection.
